name: 中华英雄
english_description: The canonical/current version of the 中华英雄 ("Chinese Hero") codebase, self-described in its own README as "FluffOS v2017版" and confirmed as the live source behind the author's own production server at mud.ren:5000. A large (~16,800-file, ~99MB) actively-maintained ES II-lineage mudlib -- master.lpc's own header credits the same lineage chain already seen in this collection's yh2003-family libs ("for ES II mudlib / original from Lil / rewritten by Annihilator (11/07/94) / modified by Xiang for XKX (12/15/95) / updated by Doing Lu for hell (2K) / Modify By Linux@lxtx for yh 2003.3"), sharing the same adm/single/master+simul_efun layout, F_DBASE property-storage architecture, and registration flow (English login id, Chinese surname+given-name, dual admin/regular password, 1-5 character-type selection, gender) as yanhuangwuhun/yhyxs -- but independently forked and substantially diverged since (byte-level diffs of master.lpc/logind.lpc/securityd.lpc/named.lpc/chinese.lpc against yanhuangwuhun's copies each run into the hundreds to low thousands of differing lines), with its own large, unique domain/quest/kungfu-skill content tree (~90+ named locations) distinct from every other yh2003-family lib already in this collection. A superseded 2006-era snapshot of an earlier fork of the same codebase (GitHub repo ZHLib) was ruled out as an onboarding candidate in an earlier research pass -- older, far smaller domain list, not the live/current version. Porting surfaced one especially high-impact driver-dialect bug: master.lpc's log_error() apply classifies a compiled file's diagnostic as a real error (vs. a benign warning) by searching for the literal substring "Warning" -- but this driver's own compiler emits lowercase "warning: ...", so the check never matched and EVERY compile warning from EVERY lazily-loaded room/NPC/item (extremely common; simple "Unused local variable" warnings appear throughout the archive) was broadcast to the connected player as a hard-error notice (the raw config default-error-message text for a normal player, or "编译时段错误：<text>" for a wizard) -- confirmed live: a single fresh room entry could show the default error message a dozen-plus times in a row. Also fixed: a UTF-8-vs-GBK byte-width mismatch in is_chinese()/check_legal_name()/named.lpc's whole "deep" PATH-macro-and-sliding-window shape (same §15h bug class as this lineage's other libs, here rejecting most real Chinese names outright); a UDP DATAGRAM socket read_callback in the live, preloaded dns_master.lpc receiving raw BUFFER packets (not the string this MudOS-era code expects) from real incoming Intermud-style "mudlist ping" traffic off the public internet; get_config(__MUD_PORT__) not coming back as a real int under a bare (int) cast (this driver's (int) cast is compile-time-only bookkeeping, not a runtime conversion) in both versiond.lpc and the shared LOCAL_PORT() macro used by messaged.lpc, each crashing socket_bind() the first time those daemons lazily loaded; report_error() declared void but its result used as a tell_object() string argument, crashing the error-reporting path itself for every non-wizard player's runtime error; a missing-macro gap (target file present, macro simply never defined) for both SKI_ZHEN (a "formation" skill base class whose own header comment names its intended macro) and IP_D; and the well-documented eventd.lpc/storyd.lpc/luban.lpc [0..<3]-vs-[0..<5] extension-rename-width bug and a message()/tell_room() 4th-argument type-strictness bug, both shared verbatim with this lineage's other already-onboarded libs. dns_master.lpc's UDP socket is a genuine, active outbound/listening network side effect -- confirmed receiving real traffic from another live Chinese MUD during testing -- so this lib should not be swept into high-frequency automated reboot loops the way most libs in this collection safely can be.
